formDescription: Personal-information branch step. Asks whether the applicant wants to verify their identity using a BC Services Card (enabling electronic delivery of the response package) or continue without it (response package collected in person).

verify_with_bcsc.title: Verify your identity using a BC Services Card?
verify_with_bcsc.description: Choosing yes redirects to BC Services Card sign-in; requires an email address on the BC Services Card account to receive the FOI response electronically. Choosing no continues the form without login, and records must be collected in person.
